title: Nutty Ethiopian Napa Cabbage Injera
description: A nutty and shattering Ethiopian dish featuring napa cabbage, made paleo-friendly and served in a donabe vessel, perfect for midnight cravings. This injera-based recipe combines the flavors of Ethiopia with the crunch of nuts and the sweetness of candy.
instructions: Preheat the donabe vessel over medium heat.
In a large bowl, combine teff flour, almond flour, and coconut sugar.
Add shredded napa cabbage, chopped hazelnuts, and candy pieces to the bowl and mix well.
Gradually add water to the bowl and mix until a thick batter forms.
Brush the donabe vessel with ghee and pour the batter into it.
Cook the injera for 2-3 minutes on each side, until it is golden brown and crispy.
Repeat the process until all the batter is used up.
Serve the nutty Ethiopian napa cabbage injera hot and enjoy.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
